name: Prediction Accuracy
query:
SELECT
	pp.item AS `Producto:Link/Item:120`,
	pp.item_name AS `Nombre del Producto::180`,
	pp.prediction_date AS `Fecha de Predicción:Date:120`,
	pp.predicted_quantity AS `Cantidad Predicha:Float:140`,
	pp.actual_quantity AS `Cantidad Real:Float:140`,
	pp.current_stock AS `Stock Actual:Float:120`,
	pp.stockout_date AS `Fecha de Agotamiento:Date:140`,
	pp.suggested_purchase_quantity AS `Compra Sugerida:Float:140`,
	CASE
		WHEN pp.actual_quantity > 0 THEN ROUND(ABS(pp.predicted_quantity - pp.actual_quantity) / NULLIF(pp.actual_quantity, 0) * 100, 2)
		ELSE NULL
	END AS `Error %:Float:120`,
	pr.name AS `Ejecución:Link/Prediction Run:120`
FROM `tabProduct Prediction` pp
LEFT JOIN `tabPrediction Run` pr ON pr.name = pp.prediction_run
WHERE pp.docstatus < 2
ORDER BY pp.prediction_date DESC, pp.item ASC
